name: Business Ethics
excerpt: Business Ethics involves moral principles guiding behavior in business.
notes:
Business ethics is a set of moral principles or values that defines right and wrong in the business context. It includes concepts like ethical dilemmas, utilitarianism, individualism, moral-rights approach, and justice approach.
